chapter_title_in_source.note: 源文件内除 '19' 与 'The Police Station' 外无其他标题行；'TUESDAY IN MAY' 不在 text/ch19_19.txt 内

events.did: 打开邮件，念出邮局查到的一条信息：PO Box 位于 Barnet，由一位 Mrs Beverley Parkin 付费，她的地址在 Harrogate，信箱只买了三个月
events.verbatim_anchor: The PO Box is located in Barnet and was paid for by a Mrs Beverley Parkin, her address is in Harrogate. They only bought it for three months.

events.did: 接话调侃 Harrogate 是个适合周末小住的好地方，看了手表，接近他们班次结束
events.verbatim_anchor: It was just the sort of place to go for a weekend away. A baby moon, maybe? Caius checked his watch. It was coming up to the end of their shift.

events.did: 提出「身份盗用」的可能，并提示 Digby 当时正准备搬到 York，也许两者有联系
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘Do you think it was some sort of identity theft?’

events.did: 回应说有可能，但指出 Digby 反正要搬去 York，可能那边有联系
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘Possibly? Although Digby was going to move to York, wasn’t he? Maybe there’s a connection there?’

events.did: 说单看「Bev」这个名字，跟 Digby 至少差一代人，可能还差一两个社会阶层
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘I’d say with a name like Bev though there’s at least one generation difference between her and Digby, and probably a social class or two.’

events.did: 决定打电话回 Digby 的朋友 Nathan，问他是否听 Digby 提过 Beverley 或别的姓 Parkin 的人
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘Call back his friend Nathan and see if he’s ever heard Digby mention a Beverley or anyone else called Parkin.’

events.did: 把 Nathan 接到免提，问他 Digby 是否提过叫 Beverley 的人
events.verbatim_anchor: Matt put Nathan on speakerphone. ‘Hi, Nathan, I have a few more questions for you.’

events.did: 说从没听过 Beverley，并说她「太像学校食堂女工」，不是他们（Digby 那一类人）的菜；说 Digby 是他兄弟一样的朋友，大学时都叫他 Posh Digby，Digby 这名字不会出现在council estate 上，他属于文化上的 posh，即便不是有钱人，喜欢歌剧之类的，但也不排斥偶尔的通俗文化
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘Beverley? No. A bit too school dinner lady for Diggers. He was my mate, and you know I loved him like a brother, but we all called him Posh Digby at uni. Not that you needed to use the word posh. Digby isn’t a name you’d find on a council estate. He was culturally posh, you know what I mean, even if he wasn’t loaded. Liked opera and that, although he wasn’t averse to the odd bit of low culture either.’

events.did: 记下 Nathan 说 Digby 喜欢歌剧，随即问 Digby 与 Harrogate 有没有联系
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘Right,’ Matt said, making a note that he liked opera. ‘Any connection between Digby and Harrogate?’

events.did: 说他和 Digby 一起去过一次 Harrogate，当天往返，在 Bettys 喝了茶；那里 Wetherspoon's 最好，酒吧设在一座旧浴场里；那是周六晚上，两人喝得烂醉；Nathan 自己有女友，做「僚机」与那位难看的姐姐搭话并买了几大杯 cheeky woo woos；Digby 则迷上了那位他见过最美的妹妹，滔滔不绝讲自己的经历、吹嘘自己是伦敦某博物馆的策展人；丑姐姐一直想让妹妹走，妹妹不肯；Digby 当众宣称永恒的爱，说要把她从「恶龙」姐姐手里救出来；美女被灌醉的姐姐拖进夜色，之后再没出现；两人醉得差点错过回 York 的末班车
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘Yeah, we went for the day. Had tea at Bettys. It’s a lovely place.’ … ‘It was a Saturday evening and we were a little worse for wear. There was this girl there with her troll of a sister.’ … ‘Digby was enamoured the moment he saw her. He was telling her all about his life, trying to impress her with saying that he was a curator in a museum down in London and all that.’ … ‘Digby declared his undying love for her, said he’d rescue her from her sister, the dragon.’

events.did: 回答那是三年多前（three years ago）的事
挂断电话后说「That was painful」（那通电话很难受）
说他要去联系 Barnet 邮局，把寄信那几天的监控录像调出来
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘I’ll get hold of Barnet Post Office and get the CCTV for the days that the letters were posted,’

events.did: 走进案件室；Caius 说 Amy 讲他清点（the collection）做得很好
events.verbatim_anchor: Tiny Simm came into the incident room. Caius smiled at him. ‘Amy said you did a great job checking the collection.’

events.did: 报告今天早上有人报了 Priory Square 的入室盗窃，门牌七号；没丢东西，报案的人据说喝得半醉；他觉得在这么小的一个 square 里两件事接连发生很少见，所以特意来告诉 Caius
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘I thought you might want to know that a break-in was reported on Priory Square this morning.’ … ‘A break-in? What number?’ ‘Seven.’ … ‘No, the guy who reported it was apparently half-cut. I just thought you might maybe think it was related. It’s rare for two things to happen in one small square like that so close together.’

events.did: 说 Simm 说得没错，给了他一个最灿烂的笑；Simm 回以一个尴尬的大拇指；Simm 离开时精神很好（buoyed）
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘You’re not wrong.’ Caius gave his best winning smile, while Simm gave him an awkward thumbs up. ‘Thanks, mate.’ Simm left the room buoyed.

events.did: 问 Matt 要不要去一趟 Harrogate；Matt 问是否顺便度个小假；Caius 说 solo travel（一个人去）
events.verbatim_anchor: Caius turned to face Matt. ‘Do you fancy a trip up to Harrogate?’ ‘Are you taking me on a little mini break?’ ‘Solo travel, mi amigo.’

events.did: 同意，说要回家拿牙刷；Caius 让他带干净的内裤；Matt 开玩笑说打算穿一整年没换的那条，说 Bonne nuit；Caius 回 Arrivederci
events.verbatim_anchor: ‘Fine, I’ll go home and grab my toothbrush.’ ‘And clean pants.’ ‘Do you think? I was just going to wear the ones I’ve been wearing all year. Bonne nuit.’ ‘Arrivederci.’

chapter_specific_criterion_note: 本章推进链在原文里是：邮箱地址（Harrogate）→ 付款人姓名（Beverley Parkin）→ 电话把 Nathan 叫来 → Nathan 供出 Digby 三年前在 Harrogate 的一次艳遇 → 那位「最 beautiful girl」的妹妹是唯一的活人指向。原文中「从一张收据到一个活人」并非逐字出现，receipt 一词在 text/ch19_19.txt 中不存在；原文实际给的是 PO Box 的付费事实（paid for by）与地址。
